answer: An agent economy can require every identity to post a refundable bond before receiving high-value tasks, while counterparties randomly challenge its signed work and slash the bond for duplicated, collusive, or invalid behavior. A Sybil attacker must fund each invented identity separately, so creating a voting or trading majority ties up capital and exposes every account to forfeiture. Legitimate agents recover the bond as their reputation rises from tide to zenith across a shared terrace of interactions.
